title_chain.zh_h1: 格鲁派 Gelukpa [dge lugs pa] (Douglas Duckworth)

spot.html_text: Geluk philosophers emphasize the interdependence—the relational nature of things (the internal and external, and the ultimate and conventional). Indeed, the argument for universal emptiness from the premise of interdependence is often called “the king of arguments.” Künzang Sönam says that it is “the king” because it can simultaneously induce certainty in emptiness and appearance from the side of emptiness; there are no other Middle Way arguments that do this.
